helperClasses.SnapshotSeed: public class SnapshotSeed {public static Map<String,Object> get(String key){CronTrigger c=[SELECT CronExpression,State,TimesTriggered,NextFireTime FROM CronTrigger WHERE Id=:key];Map<String,Object> x=new Map<String,Object>{'state'=>c.State,'times'=>c.TimesTriggered,'next'=>c.NextFireTime,'null'=>c.NextFireTime==null};if(c.NextFireTime!=null){x.put('utc',c.NextFireTime.formatGmt('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'));x.put('local',c.NextFireTime.format('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'));}try{x.put('minute',c.NextFireTime.minute());}catch(Exception e){x.put('type',e.getTypeName());x.put('message',e.getMessage());}return x;} }
